g.title: iih_qsp
g.text: Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension — QSP mechanistic map
CSF secretion · outflow resistance · collapsible-sinus venous floor · abdominal–venous coupling · papilloedema · therapy PK/PD
therapy nodes are coloured by WHICH TERM of ICP = I_f·R_out + P_sss they act on
blue drugs are bounded by the orange term — that bound is the point of the map

g.title: cluster_abdo
g.text: 2. Abdominal → thoracic → central venous chain (sets P_cv, the base of the floor)

g.title: cluster_secretion
g.text: 3. CSF secretion — choroid plexus epithelium (sets I_f ≈ 0.35 mL/min)

g.title: cluster_outflow
g.text: 4. CSF outflow pathways (sets R_out; normal 6–10 mmHg/(mL/min))

g.title: cluster_venous
g.text: 5. Dural venous sinus — collapsible tube, amplifier and FLOOR

g.title: cluster_optic
g.text: 7. Optic nerve head — pressure → axoplasmic stasis → axon loss

g.title: cluster_tx_secretion
g.text: 11a. Therapy acting on SECRETION (I_f) — bounded by the venous floor

g.title: cluster_tx_other
g.text: 11b. Therapy acting on the FLOOR, on P_cv, or bypassing the equation

g.title: cluster_lesson
g.text: 13. What the structure implies for trials and models

g.title: cluster_legend
g.text: Legend — therapy colour = which term of ICP = I_f·R_out + P_sss it acts on

g.title: FLOOR
g.text: can cross it at any dose

g.title: LESSON3
g.text: Potency and loop gain are confounded

g.title: LESSON1
g.text: BOUND: any secretion drug is capped
patients that cap is ABOVE remission,
so failure is structural, not dosing.

g.title: INTEGRAL
g.text: — not a function of today's pressure

g.title: RGCL
g.text: IIHTT: thinned MORE on ACZ (3.6 vs 2.1 µm)

g.title: LESSON2
g.text: STATE vs INTEGRAL: ICP is a state,
vision is an integral. A 6-month ICP

g.title: LESSON4
g.text: mix a reversible and an irreversible

g.title: TX_STENT
g.text: weight UP and drug dose DOWN

g.title: L4
g.text: acts on P_cv via the abdomen
